BACKEND01.title: Backend Engineer | Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS
BACKEND01.summary: Backend engineer who ships Python services that stay correct under real-world failure. I design REST APIs, background jobs and data pipelines, own on-call for what I build, and I'm comfortable taking a feature from a vague ticket to a monitored production deploy.

DATAENG01.title: Data Engineer | Python, Airflow, PostgreSQL, AWS
DATAENG01.summary: Engineer who builds pipelines that keep running when upstream data doesn't behave. I design ETL jobs (Python, Airflow) that reconcile messy external data into clean, queryable tables, and the REST APIs and monitoring around them.
DATAENG01.extra: Open to data platform / analytics engineering titles as well
